newsitem.title: CANADA: Avenor not pursuing talks at this time.
newsitem.headline: Avenor not pursuing talks at this time.

text.p: Avenor Inc, whose shareholders earlier rejected the company's proposed C$2.6 billion acquisition of Repap Enterprises Inc, is not pursuing talks with Repap or Domtar Inc at this time, chief executive Paul Gagne said on Wednesday.

"We are not pursuing discussions with Domtar at this time," Gagne told a news conference after a special shareholders meeting, adding: "We are not pursuing discussions with Repap." Avenor said on Monday that it rejected a friendly offer from rival pulp and paper maker Domtar to merge with it and Repap.
